audience: ecommerce stores that send email and WhatsApp campaigns with Retainful

useCases.title: Find contacts and check their consent
useCases.text: List contacts one page at a time, with their consent status and source. Open one contact by its id to read its attributes.

useCases.title: Review the lists and segments
useCases.text: List the lists and segments with their ids. Open one by id to read its details before you add contacts to it.

useCases.title: Add a new subscriber to a list
useCases.text: Create or update a contact by email and add it to a list in one call. Set the email consent only for people who really opted in. A list can start an automation.

useCases.title: Create a contact from a new sign-up
useCases.text: Create a contact from a new sign-up, or update it when the email or phone already exists. Set the email consent explicitly. This does not add the contact to a list.

useCases.title: Record a renewal event on a contact
useCases.text: Record one event on a contact's timeline, such as a renewal with its amount. Automations that the event triggers can email the contact.
